verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents upserts, deletes and delete-by-filter, and states that writes appear in search results immediately through incremental SPFresh indexing. Namespace metadata also exposes the count of write-ahead-log rows not yet indexed, which gives some visibility into freshness. Missing for 10: an explicit consistency-model description (e.g., strong vs eventual read semantics) and independent or hands-on corroboration of write-to-query freshness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upsert and delete records continuously and have changes reflected in search results quickly, with documented freshness/consistency behavior

citations.quote: Vectors are incrementally indexed in an SPFresh vector index for performant search. Writes appear in search results immediately.
Conditional writes: upsert, patch, or delete a document only if a condition.
Delete by filter: deletes documents that match a filter.
The number of rows in the write-ahead log that have not yet been indexed.
